title: Principal Engineer at Semtech Corporation Is More Optimistic About Credo’s Diversification Despite Optical DSP Headwinds
expert: Principal Engineer, AI data-center interconnects, Semtech (competitor; current, 2 yrs)
verdict: A competitor engineer (no Credo orders or pricing of his own) puts Credo at 80–90% of the AEC business and at five of six major hyperscalers, but sees its optical-DSP line fading toward LPO/NPO/CPO.

AEC durability through 1.6T / Rubin: 🟢 **80–90% of the AEC business** (estimate), in line with JPM's ~81% (SB #61029) and Edgewater's ~80% at xAI (SB #49503). → Tenet 1 (AEC base) ↑
🟡 **AEC reach 5–7 meters** vs 1.5 m for passive copper at 200G/lane (estimate); Third Bridge put 1.6T AEC reach at ~5-6m (SB #64451): consistent.
Optical portfolio (the needle-mover): 🔴 **Optical-DSP demand fading** as LPO, NPO and CPO take over, and Credo lacks the **2 nm / 3 nm** nodes Marvell and Broadcom use; conflicts with mgmt's >$100M FY27 optical-DSP line (SB #64381). → Tenet 2 (ZF Optics \$1B+) ↓

changes: AEC share 80–90% (expert estimate) vs JPM model ~81% (SB #61029) and Edgewater ~80% at xAI (SB #49503): consistent.
Five of six major hyperscalers (expert) vs mgmt 'deep relationships with 5 hyperscalers' on the 2026-09-01 call (SB #49530): consistent.
AEC reach 5–7 m (expert) vs Third Bridge ~5-6m at 1.6T (SB #64451): consistent.

Optical DSP 'fading' and a node behind Marvell/Broadcom (expert) vs ex-Inphi exec 'a notch behind Marvell' (SB #64373): consistent; vs mgmt FY27 optical DSP >\$100M within >\$600M optical (SB #64381): conflicting.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (AEC base): ↑ — 80–90% AEC share and five of six hyperscalers, no visible AEC challenger (estimate).
Tenet 2 (ZF Optics \$1B+): ↓ — optical DSP demand seen fading to LPO/NPO/CPO; DSP trails at 40 dB / 2-3 nm. Not quantified.
Tenet 4 (new products / Dust→CPO): ↑ — expert more optimistic on DustPhotonics/Hyperlume photonics diversification; coherent a 5+ year opportunity.
